title: Staff who run many one-to-one calls rarely get feedback on them, because nobody has time to read the transcripts.
context: Calls are recorded with consent and transcribed, so the material exists. A first attempt at asking a model to score a call gave safe, middling answers that nobody trusted. The feedback must quote the transcript, admit when there is not enough evidence, and stay private to the person who ran the call.
postedBy: A team lead at an organisation that runs one-to-one calls at scale
